title: Maximum Sum of 3 Non-Overlapping Subarrays
summary: Given an integer array, find three non-overlapping subarrays of a specified length with the maximum sum.
statement: Given an integer array, find three non-overlapping subarrays of a specified length with the maximum sum. Return the starting indices of these subarrays, ensuring they are lexicographically smallest if multiple solutions exist.
constraints: Return starts of three non-overlapping length-k subarrays with maximum total sum; break ties lexicographically.
hints: Fixing the middle window separates the optimal left and right choices.
Precompute window sums plus best prefix and suffix window indices with careful tie directions.
For each middle, combine left[middle-k], middle, and right[middle+k].
Strict prefix updates retain early ties, while reverse suffix updates retain the earliest suffix; scanning middles left-to-right completes lexicographic tie-breaking.
editorial: Strict prefix updates retain early ties, while reverse suffix updates retain the earliest suffix; scanning middles left-to-right completes lexicographic tie-breaking.

tests.explanation: The windows starting at 0, 3, and 5 have the maximum total.
Several triples tie, and [0,2,4] is lexicographically smallest.
